title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Trio #29 (세로 띠·매끈 / 동심원·물결 / 가로 띠·매끈)

Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.
